title: Regression: syntax error in run_tests.sh after PR16020
author: nobutomonakano-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Previous Working Version

01716112b78f7fb7bd3036707df1c0689f59ad74

### Steps to Reproduce

``
./run_tests.sh: line 16: syntax error near unexpected token `('
``
``
 ./run_tests.sh: line 16: `    echo "    -H <dpu name>  " specify comma-separated DPU names (default: none)"'
``
line 16 was introduced by
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/16020/files

### Impact of this regression

unable to run tests
